about: Change-based, self-describing sensor records from HONE devices. One JSON object per line (JSONL), gzip-compressed per 15-minute window (window = floor(unix_seconds / 900)). Times are RFC3339 UTC. Any moment can be rebuilt from the last keyframe plus later events: appeared/changed set a key, disappeared removes it, unchanged and gap change nothing.
privacy: Personal identifiers never appear in the clear: Wi-Fi BSSIDs and SSIDs, BLE MACs and LoRa DevAddrs are replaced by tokens (truncated SHA-256 over area, ISO week and the identifier). Human speech is never recorded (bird clips only). Locations are H3 cells, coarsened to res 7 at or near home or with no home known, at most res 9 elsewhere.

events.appeared: A key was observed that is not in the current state. Carries v (value) and a (attributes).
events.disappeared: A family member was missing from consecutive full scans (2 by default). Carries prev.
events.changed: A value moved past its deadband from the last reported value. Carries v and prev.
events.unchanged: Explicit marker. k = '<family>:*' means every key of that family not mentioned is unchanged since 'since'; a metric key with forced=true is the 15-minute climate sample, carrying its current value v.
events.gap: No data for a family between 'from' and 'to', with a reason.

gap_reasons.offline: Device or collector not running or not reachable.
gap_reasons.permission_denied: The OS refused the permission needed (location, Bluetooth scan, microphone).
gap_reasons.speech_deleted: Audio in this span contained human speech and was deleted on the device; nothing was kept.
gap_reasons.no_signal: The sensor ran and observed nothing.
gap_reasons.sensor_absent: The device has no such sensor.
gap_reasons.app_stopped: The app or collector was stopped by the user or the OS.

hone.raw.hdr@1.description: First line of every blob: who recorded it, where, with what.

dev.description: Device id: first 16 hex of the device/seat public key.

sensors.description: Sensor model, vendor, resolution and calibration per key prefix.

area.description: On-device coarse area for this window.

cell.description: H3 cell id (15 hex), or null if every source failed.

acc_m.description: Estimated accuracy of the source, metres.

inferred.description: True when the area did not come from a live fix this window.

age_s.description: Age of the fix the area came from, seconds.

hone.raw.kf@1.description: Keyframe: the full state. Sent once per device per UTC day, at boot, and after any gap.

wifi:<token>.what: Received signal strength of one Wi-Fi access point.

ble:<token>.what: Received signal strength of one BLE advertiser (token rotates daily).

lora:<token>.what: LoRaWAN uplink from one device (DevAddr token rotates daily).

flipper:<id>.what: Signal of a HONE Flipper heard over BLE.

env.air_temp_c.what: Ambient air temperature from a real ambient sensor.

dev.temp_c.what: Temperature of the device itself (phone battery, Pi CPU). NOT air temperature.

attrs.clip: sha256 of the bird-only audio clip, if kept
